sources.entry: Agent Skills by Anthropic - Anthropic's official repository for Agent Skills — the SKILL.md format, a skill template, and example skills, the same format Claude Code loads natively.

summary.one_liner: Anthropic's official repository of Agent Skills for Claude: folders of SKILL.md instructions, scripts, and resources, with a template, the spec, and example skills.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds example skills that Claude loads on demand to handle specialized tasks, ranging from creative work (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) and enterprise workflows (communications, branding). Each skill lives in its own folder with a SKILL.md file containing YAML frontmatter (name and description) and the instructions Claude follows. The repo includes a ./skills directory of examples, a ./spec directory with the Agent Skills specification, and a ./template directory with a skill template. It also includes document creation and editing skills for docx, pdf, pptx, and xlsx under skills/, which the README describes as the same ones powering Claude's document capabilities. The README says the skills are for demonstration and educational purposes and should be tested before critical use.
use_cases: Starting a new custom skill from a template
Learning the SKILL.md format and patterns
how_to_run: In Claude Code, run: /plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills
Select Browse and install plugins, then anthropic-agent-skills
Choose document-skills or example-skills and select Install now
Copy the template-skill folder as a starting point for a new SKILL.md skill
notable: Official reference implementation of Claude's skills system using the SKILL.md format that Claude Code loads natively
Includes a skill template and the Agent Skills specification in ./spec
Document skills for docx, pdf, pptx, and xlsx provided as a production reference
Installable as Claude Code plugins grouped into document-skills and example-skills
Partner skill example listed for Notion
caveats: Examples are provided for demonstration and educational purposes only; behavior in Claude may differ from what the skills show
Document skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) are source-available, not open source
Example skills are available to paid plans in Claude.ai
summary.license: Apache 2.0 for many skills; document skills are source-available (not open source)
